findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
Inspectors observed the following to have grease deposits and soil accumulations:
- The pizza oven and pizza oven tray have accumulations of grease deposit.
- The pizza oven locker have accumulations of food debris.
- The soda gun hoster have soil accumulations (COS).

Person-in-charge was informed and the non-food contact surfaces stated above would be cleaned. The soda gun hoster was cleaned during inspection, PIC also stated the soda gun hoster is changed every 6 months and would be contacting an operator to change it. Ensure all non-food contact surfaces are cleaned regularly and kept free of grease deposits and soil accumulations. [C]
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(B) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations.
